final: WITH race_counts AS (SELECT raceId, COUNT(*) AS qualifying_count FROM qualifying GROUP BY raceId), totals AS (SELECT SUM(qualifying_count) AS total FROM race_counts) SELECT rc.raceId, rc.qualifying_count, 1.0 * rc.qualifying_count / t.total AS ratio FROM race_counts AS rc CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
